hooks.command:
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -f "$d/.claude/gate-off" ] && exit 0
f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1 | tr '\' '/' | tr -s '/')
if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: approval hook could not parse the tool payload, so it cannot verify this edit is covered by an approved spec. Failing closed. Report at https://github.com/trackmind-ai/sdlc-atlas/issues"; exit 2; fi
case "/$f/" in */../*) echo "BLOCKED: path contains '..', cannot verify it is covered by an approved spec."; exit 2;; esac
n() { tr '\' '/' | tr -s '/' | sed 's#^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/#\1:/#' | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'; }
F=$(printf %s "$f" | n); R=$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && { pwd -W 2>/dev/null || pwd; } | n); rel=
case "$F" in "$R"/*) rel=$(printf %s "$f" | cut -c$((${#R}+2))-);; esac
if [ -n "$rel" ]; then
  case "$rel" in .claude/*|docs/*|designs/*|knowledge.md|*/knowledge.md|README|README.*|*/README|*/README.*|.gitignore|*/.gitignore|CHANGELOG|CHANGELOG.*|*/CHANGELOG|*/CHANGELOG.*) exit 0;; esac
else
  case "$f" in */.claude/*) exit 0;; esac
fi
[ -f "$d/.claude/memory/approvals/ACTIVE" ] || { echo "BLOCKED: no approved spec. Production-code edits require an approval marker (.claude/memory/approvals/ACTIVE). Run /approve-spec, approve a /fix, or confirm /bootstrap. Escape hatch for non-pipeline work: touch .claude/gate-off (visible in git status)."; exit 2; }
exit 0
